definitions.rationale: Expands the nullary loopBody proof term into the exact loop-body AST; this is a named syntax definition, not an execution rule or added fact.
definitions.text:
rule loopBody =>
    If(Compare(Name("char"), CmpOp("==", Str("("))),
      AugAssign(Name("depth"), "+", Int(1))
      If(Compare(Name("depth"), CmpOp(">", Name("deepest"))),
        Assign(Name("deepest"), Name("depth")),
        .Stmts),
      If(Compare(Name("char"), CmpOp("==", Str(")"))),
        AugAssign(Name("depth"), "-", Int(1)),
        If(Compare(Name("deepest"), CmpOp(">", Int(0))),
          Expr(Call(Attribute(Name("depths"), "append"), Name("deepest")))
          Assign(Name("deepest"), Int(0)),
          .Stmts)))

definitions.rationale: Expands afterLoop into the final conditional append and return AST, defining a named program fragment.
definitions.text:
rule afterLoop =>
    If(Compare(Name("deepest"), CmpOp(">", Int(0))),
      Expr(Call(Attribute(Name("depths"), "append"), Name("deepest"))),
      .Stmts)
    Return(Name("depths"))

definitions.rationale: Defines solutionBody by composing the initialization statements, exact loop term, and after-loop fragment.
definitions.text:
rule solutionBody =>
    Assign(Name("depths"), ListExpr(.Exprs))
    Assign(Name("depth"), Int(0))
    Assign(Name("deepest"), Int(0))
    Assign(Name("char"), Str(""))
    For(Name("char"), Name("paren_string"), loopBody)
    afterLoop

definitions.rationale: Defines solutionModule as the translated import and function-definition AST containing solutionBody.
definitions.text:
rule solutionModule =>
    Module(
      ImportFrom("typing", "List")
      FuncDef("parse_nested_parens", Params("paren_string"), solutionBody))

definitions.rationale: Defines nextDepth for an opening-parenthesis code by incrementing the current depth.
definitions.text:
rule nextDepth(C, D) => D +Int 1
    requires C ==Int 40

definitions.rationale: Defines nextDepth for a closing-parenthesis code by decrementing the current depth.
definitions.text:
rule nextDepth(C, D) => D -Int 1
    requires C ==Int 41

definitions.rationale: Completes the nextDepth character partition by preserving depth for every non-parenthesis code.
definitions.text:
rule nextDepth(C, D) => D
    requires C =/=Int 40 andBool C =/=Int 41

definitions.rationale: Provides the empty-sequence base equation for the structurally recursive scanDepth summary.
definitions.text: rule scanDepth(.IntSeq, D) => D

definitions.rationale: Provides the cons recurrence for scanDepth, consuming one code and recursing through nextDepth.
definitions.text: rule scanDepth(iCons(C, R), D) => scanDepth(R, nextDepth(C, D))

definitions.rationale: Defines openDeepest to select the incremented depth when it exceeds the prior maximum.
definitions.text:
rule openDeepest(D, M) => D +Int 1
    requires D +Int 1 >Int M

definitions.rationale: Defines the complementary openDeepest case by retaining the prior maximum.
definitions.text:
rule openDeepest(D, M) => M
    requires D +Int 1 <=Int M

definitions.rationale: Defines delimiterDeepest to reset a positive completed-group maximum to zero.
definitions.text:
rule delimiterDeepest(M) => 0
    requires M >Int 0

definitions.rationale: Defines the complementary delimiterDeepest case by preserving a nonpositive value.
definitions.text:
rule delimiterDeepest(M) => M
    requires M <=Int 0

definitions.rationale: Defines nextDeepest on an opening-parenthesis code through the openDeepest helper.
definitions.text:
rule nextDeepest(C, D, M) => openDeepest(D, M)
    requires C ==Int 40

definitions.rationale: Defines nextDeepest on a closing-parenthesis code by retaining the current maximum.
definitions.text:
rule nextDeepest(C, _D, M) => M
    requires C ==Int 41

definitions.rationale: Completes the nextDeepest character partition by applying delimiterDeepest to other codes.
definitions.text:
rule nextDeepest(C, _D, M) => delimiterDeepest(M)
    requires C =/=Int 40 andBool C =/=Int 41

definitions.rationale: Provides the empty-sequence base equation for the scanDeepest recurrence.
definitions.text: rule scanDeepest(.IntSeq, _D, M) => M

definitions.rationale: Defines scanDeepest structurally on a cons by updating depth and maximum and recurring on the tail.
definitions.text:
rule scanDeepest(iCons(C, R), D, M)
    => scanDeepest(R, nextDepth(C, D), nextDeepest(C, D, M))

definitions.rationale: Defines delimiterOutput for a positive group maximum by appending that maximum to the accumulator.
definitions.text:
rule delimiterOutput(M, OUT) => valSeqConcat(OUT, vCons(M, .ValSeq))
    requires M >Int 0

definitions.rationale: Defines the complementary delimiterOutput case as the unchanged accumulator.
definitions.text:
rule delimiterOutput(M, OUT) => OUT
    requires M <=Int 0

definitions.rationale: Defines nextOutput for an opening parenthesis as no output change.
definitions.text:
rule nextOutput(C, _M, OUT) => OUT
    requires C ==Int 40

definitions.rationale: Defines nextOutput for a closing parenthesis as no output change.
definitions.text:
rule nextOutput(C, _M, OUT) => OUT
    requires C ==Int 41

definitions.rationale: Completes the nextOutput character partition by delegating non-parenthesis codes to delimiterOutput.
definitions.text:
rule nextOutput(C, M, OUT) => delimiterOutput(M, OUT)
    requires C =/=Int 40 andBool C =/=Int 41

definitions.rationale: Provides the empty-sequence base equation for scanOutput.
definitions.text: rule scanOutput(.IntSeq, _D, _M, OUT) => OUT

definitions.rationale: Defines the scanOutput cons recurrence by consuming one code and updating its depth, maximum, and output parameters.
definitions.text:
rule scanOutput(iCons(C, R), D, M, OUT)
    => scanOutput(R, nextDepth(C, D), nextDeepest(C, D, M),
                  nextOutput(C, M, OUT))

definitions.rationale: Provides the empty-sequence base equation for the last-character scan summary.
definitions.text: rule scanChar(.IntSeq, CH) => CH

definitions.rationale: Defines scanChar on a cons by recording the head as the current character and recurring on the tail.
definitions.text: rule scanChar(iCons(C, R), _CH) => scanChar(R, str(iCons(C, .IntSeq)))

definitions.rationale: Defines finishOutput for a positive final maximum by appending that maximum to the scanned output.
definitions.text:
rule finishOutput(CS, D, M, OUT)
    => valSeqConcat(scanOutput(CS, D, M, OUT),
                    vCons(scanDeepest(CS, D, M), .ValSeq))
    requires scanDeepest(CS, D, M) >Int 0

definitions.rationale: Defines the complementary finishOutput case as the scanned output without a final append.
definitions.text:
rule finishOutput(CS, D, M, OUT) => scanOutput(CS, D, M, OUT)
    requires scanDeepest(CS, D, M) <=Int 0

definitions.rationale: Defines expectedDepths by initializing finishOutput with zero depth, zero maximum, and an empty output accumulator.
definitions.text: rule expectedDepths(CS) => finishOutput(CS, 0, 0, .ValSeq)

definitions.rationale: Defines the wellFormedStep opening-parenthesis case by incrementing depth and recurring.
definitions.text:
rule wellFormedStep(C, R, D) => wellFormed(R, D +Int 1)
    requires C ==Int 40

definitions.rationale: Defines the guarded closing-parenthesis wellFormedStep case, requiring positive depth before recurring at depth minus one.
definitions.text:
rule wellFormedStep(C, R, D) => D >Int 0 andBool wellFormed(R, D -Int 1)
    requires C ==Int 41

definitions.rationale: Defines the ASCII-space wellFormedStep case by requiring depth zero and recurring unchanged.
definitions.text:
rule wellFormedStep(C, R, D) => D ==Int 0 andBool wellFormed(R, D)
    requires C ==Int 32

definitions.rationale: Completes the wellFormedStep code partition by defining every non-parenthesis, non-space code as invalid.
definitions.text:
rule wellFormedStep(C, _R, _D) => false
    requires C =/=Int 40 andBool C =/=Int 41 andBool C =/=Int 32

definitions.rationale: Defines the empty-input wellFormed base case as final depth zero.
definitions.text: rule wellFormed(.IntSeq, D) => D ==Int 0

definitions.rationale: Defines the wellFormed cons recurrence by dispatching the head code through wellFormedStep.
definitions.text: rule wellFormed(iCons(C, R), D) => wellFormedStep(C, R, D)

definitions.rationale: Defines validInput as the wellFormed predicate initialized at nesting depth zero.
definitions.text: rule validInput(CS) => wellFormed(CS, 0)
